description: Laioutr is the agentic frontend management platform that combines Studio (visual editor), Frontend (performance layer), Orchestr (backend integrations), and Laioutr Cloud (hosting) into a single platform. Developers no longer need to manually maintain integrations, while marketing and content teams can independently design pages, launch campaigns, and manage content via a unified interface - without requiring an engineering ticket for every adjustment.
